test_pl_fold: test the pl.fold function that accumulates values across columns using an accumulator expression and lambda function
test_pl_reduce: test the pl.reduce function that reduces all columns without an explicit initial accumulator expression
test_pl_cum_fold: test the pl.cum_fold function that produces cumulative fold results across all columns row-wise
test_pl_cum_reduce: test the pl.cum_reduce function that produces cumulative reduce results across all columns row-wise
test_alias_prune_in_fold: test that pl.fold correctly prunes aliases when combining conditional expressions with an accumulator
